The '''''Orca''-class freighter'''<ref name="SW Kids" /> was a class of civilian [[freighter]] that saw use during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. One ''Orca''-class, [[Freighter 2716]], was used by the [[Galactic Empire]] as part of [[Project Stardust]] and delivered a large [[kyber crystal]] to the [[Tonnis sector]].<ref name="ITNOTR" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Orca''-class freighter appeared in the episode "[[In the Name of the Rebellion]]" of the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' animated television series. The [[Wikipedia:Orca|orca]] is a species of [[Wikipedia:Dolphin|dolphin]] in real-world.<ref name="ITNOTR" />
